about_the_game:
Unlock the full audio experience of Warnament. Early musical ideas and final soundtrack versions await you.

Attention-grabbing drum sounds keep players on edge, reminding them of battles raging in the background, while calm, slow-paced tracks capture the feeling of peaceful time and the development of the country.

Composers – Arman Mkhitarian and Aizek Stellar.

The tracks are available in two formats: MP3 44100 Hz 192kb/s and FLAC 44100 Hz 24bit.

As a bonus, this pack also includes 4 tracks from the early versions of the game in MP3 format.

To play the Soundtrack, find it in your Steam Library.

P.S. Your purchase helps the developers continue improving the game. Thank you for your support!
